cautions: High, open terrain at 1,735–2,135 m: little shade and quick weather changes.
Cows graze the alpine pastures in summer: keep your dog close.
Scree and rocky stretches below the Aferer Geisler: watch your dog’s paws.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
